label: Agent-guided discovery pilot on the six unresolved Fourth Way targets
summary: Agent-guided discovery pilot (#1832) on the six Fourth Way targets left unresolved by #1826: PerfectionsOfEffectPreexistInCause 64498e7e, GodIsMaximalInBeing 4c79298d, GradesByApproachToAMaximum 6c27657f, GradesFoundInThings a9622441, MaximumInBeingIsFirstBeing eaa4c679, MostTrueIsMostBeing 101bdd62. Baseline (no AI): truth discover at 495c8f19f, Duper only, pool all, 8 candidates, 100k heartbeats (the next-test rerun of Phase A, report 20261122T143055Z): all six unresolved (about 361 s of goal time). Guided runs on the same checkout, targets, pool and budget: G1 retrieval widened to 24 candidates (report 20261122T150930Z, 595 s): five unresolved; GradesFoundInThings closed only from GradesByApproachToAMaximum with QuartaViaUnboundedDegrees, a recorded incompatible bundle (argument 4723de84), filtered as domain_by_name and senses (BEING_1/BEING_3, MAXIMAL _1/_2/_6 mixing). G2a, the same budget with a temporary whole-binder tag overlay (scripts/discover_blueprint.py oracle; carriers Being/B/Entity and Respect/R tagged with temporary senses, InAct/Has, MoreIn, CausesIn, esse/being, IsGod and PriorSimply with IN_ACT_4, MORE_1, CAUSE_2, the esse frame sense, GOD_4 and PRIOR_1, over the 42 declarations of the targets and their known derivations; report 20261122T150131Z, 328 s): all six unresolved; the overlay unified the retrieved binders but the known premises were still not retrieved. Missing bridges proposed there (CausesIn c x r implies InAct c r; PriorSimply x y implies IsGod x; InAct x r implies IsGod x) are the #1826 candidates again, far stronger than any recorded reading, and are not adopted. Diagnosis (scripts/discover_blueprint.py diagnose with the binder export scripts/DiscoverBinders.lean): every target already has verified conditional derivations, and for every one of them the run both failed to retrieve at least one premise and would have needed a binder identification no tag records. Precise identification obligations: 101bdd62 needs Aristotle's AsToBeingSoToTruthReading binders Entity, Has, truth, being read as Being, InAct, verum, esse (the verified argument 8542e377 already makes this identification by instantiation; #1826 left Has untagged); 4c79298d needs the GodMaximalCausal and PreexistenceWithoutTransfer carriers B, R and their IsGod, CausesIn, MoreIn, esse identified with StageTwo's; 6c27657f needs ExceededPerfectionIsCaused, InMetaphysicam's no-regress and PreexistenceWithoutTransfer's CausesIn identified (carriers Being/Respect match only by the flagged name fallback); eaa4c679's known routes need the NecessaryRootFork/SelectedAncestry W, B, m, w world-profile vocabulary; a9622441's known route is the cogito route (Descartes lane, not pursued). Identification oracle in Lean (explicit identification, Duper): 101bdd62 from 5a948c37, 4c79298d from the bundle of 4d1efe91, and 6c27657f from the bundle of c201b61a each close in seconds, so for these the obstacle is retrieval plus identification, not proof search; 4c79298d without MoreInIsAsymmetric timed out (unresolved, not a countermodel). Lemma DAG (AND/OR, statuses: V verified theorem, C candidate lemma, O open): eaa4c679 OR {V known 3fdc8ab7/1375ca5f/f53dd124 (8-9 premises each)} OR {C new: 70e98bb5 SimplyPriorIsCauseOfBeing (O, derived conditionally from 47aff057+5dacb0db) AND 18561596 MaximumHasNoDistinctEsseCause (derived from d5a94eb1 by 8bbe817d, previously idle: no argument used it) AND ee4ab504}. The candidate was proved in Lean (zero axioms) with omission and nonvacuity controls and registered as result c9bdd003 (argument d27dd642) and controls result 0cfadbaf. It explains the recorded objection fc556abf: that formal fact keeps SimplyPriorIsCauseOfBeing and refutes the bridge, so it must violate 18561596. The baseline had 18561596 among the candidates but not 70e98bb5; at 24 candidates and under the overlay 70e98bb5 was still not retrieved for this target (it was retrieved for 64498e7e), a pure retrieval gap. Rejected candidates: (1) 4c79298d from GodIsOne 33b18ae7, SomeBeingMaximalInBeing fad8af3e and MaximeEnsIsGod 957a71fe: MaximeEnsIsGod is GOD_2 and the target GOD_4 with no bridge between them (semantic mismatch), and GodIsOne's routes c719249b/bc0cff0b/969ae822 use GodIsMaximalInBeing itself (support cycle); only d602ba9e is independent, and the GOD_2/GOD_4 gap remains. (2) 4c79298d via 'whatever is more in being is simply prior' plus God as first being: no corpus statement supplies the bridge MoreIn esse y x implies PriorSimply y x; it would be a new OPEN premise, not proposed. (3) 6c27657f from an all-respects no-infinite-ascent premise (generalizing Round3FourthWay.NoInfiniteAscentInBeing) and MoreSuchHasThePerfection c11369aa: valid but adds a new OPEN premise and duplicates the at-esse gradesAscent route; not registered. (4) lean-auto closures of f8ba2429 (inconsistent core of recorded rivals 3143560d and 64498e7e) and 1ec205ed (known argument 529e5318, GOD_1/2/4 mixing): filtered noise. (5) The three G2a missing bridges: rejected as above. Remaining: 64498e7e now has the merged route f8ba2429 + 634a80b8 (#1835, result 77485e04), not re-registered here; 101bdd62, 4c79298d and 6c27657f need reviewed sense tags (carrier senses for Being/B/Entity and Respect/R, Has as IN_ACT_4) before discover can compose their known routes; a9622441 belongs to the cogito lane.
blocker: Next tests: (1) author and review whole-binder sense tags for the carriers Being/B/Entity and Respect/R (a Respect sense record is missing, #1823 follow-up) and for Aristotle's Has (IN_ACT_4?), then rerun the baseline; the diagnosis predicts 101bdd62, 4c79298d and 6c27657f become filtered as known. (2) Improve retrieval so that a candidate whose conclusion-side vocabulary matches a target's hypothesis (SimplyPriorIsCauseOfBeing for eaa4c679, AsToBeingSoToTruth for 101bdd62) ranks within the budget; at 24 candidates both were still missed. (3) Warrant research on 70e98bb5 and on the causal-comparison premise d5a94eb1 behind 18561596, now the whole remaining load of the short route to eaa4c679.
